# Prepared archives

Current package: [iteathen-isomax-0.2.0-rc.1.tgz](iteathen-isomax-0.2.0-rc.1.tgz).
Extract the complete `package/` folder, then run `node verify.mjs` and
`node run.mjs`. No installation is needed. See its README for memory and affinity.
Registry publication remains disabled.

[VERIFICATION.json](VERIFICATION.json) records historical checksums and qualification. [SHA256SUMS](SHA256SUMS) covers all three archives. The rc.2 archive and its [original verification](VERIFICATION-rc2.json) remain preserved for recovery and comparison.

[VERIFICATION-0.2.0-rc.1.json](VERIFICATION-0.2.0-rc.1.json) records current
qualification, including a standalone extracted empty-board solve. The older
rc.2/rc.3 archives and verification files are historical.
